summary.text: Nyamal Dei is the Democratic candidate for the North Dakota State Senate, District 41, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican incumbent Kyle Davison.
A former refugee and nonprofit founder who has served on the Fargo Board of Education, she says she is focused on schools, health care and workforce opportunity.

paragraphs.text: Dei earned a bachelor's degree from North Dakota State University in 2013 and a graduate degree from Benedictine University in 2022, and Ballotpedia lists her profession as nonprofit founder.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a former refugee, a mother and a public health professional who started over in Fargo, and as a nonprofit executive director and elected member of the Fargo Board of Education.
Ballotpedia lists the Fargo Board of Education At-large seat as her prior office.
Dei advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026, receiving 1,418 votes.
In her survey, she said she would fight for strong schools and quality education and work to strengthen the workforce and support working families.
She named education, access to health and mental health care, and stable work with dignity as her policy interests, and listed the District 41 Democratic-NPL Party as an endorser.
